description:
Create a Sentry Metric Monitor that detects when a metric, such as an error count or latency, crosses a static, percent-change, or dynamic threshold. New monitors start active.
Copy a monitor's setup from get_metric_monitor_details. Notifications come from Alerts: create_alert_rule. Cron jobs: find_monitors. URL checks: find_uptime_monitors.
Creation can persist before an error or timeout; check find_metric_monitors before retrying.

conditionGroup.description: Complete detection conditions; copied IDs are dropped. Static and Percent use threshold conditions, including a resolved one. Dynamic uses one anomaly_detection condition.

comparison.description: Threshold value. For Percent detection it is an absolute percentage of the earlier window: 110 means 10% higher.

config.description: Detection mode: Static thresholds, Percent change against an earlier window (needs comparisonDeltaSeconds), or Dynamic anomaly detection (needs enough history).

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

owner.description: Owner as user:<id> or team:<id>. Null clears it.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

query.description: Complete metric query. Omit environment for all environments.

dataset.description: `metrics` is crash-free releases. `events_analytics_platform` covers spans, logs, and application metrics, chosen by eventTypes.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

workflowIds.description: Alert workflow IDs to connect, from find_alert_rules with `issue`. Omit to create with no Alerts.

name: create_metric_monitor

conditionGroup.description: Native detection conditions, including resolution. Results: 75 critical, 50 warning, 0 resolved. Percent comparisons are absolute percentages (110 means 10% higher). Dynamic comparisons contain sensitivity, seasonality and thresholdType.

title: Create Metric Monitor
